answer: The bond unlocks in twelve monthly slices and each slice requires a clean grading record that month, so an identity must stay honest for a year to recover its money. A thousand aliases lock a thousand bonds for a year, and one bad month freezes the slice for all of them, while an honest agent unlocks one slice a month. The lantern of the design is public, the spiral of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the glacier of honest work is what finally pays.
